name: tiingo-v0.4-feature-groups
data_kind: Tiingo EOD current-vintage adjusted data from 2002 (development only)
question: Do three predeclared feature groups (trend strength, volatility change, stock-bond correlation) improve strategy selection over the frozen v1 features, holding everything else fixed?

decision_gates.primary: selector Sharpe exceeds equal-weight Sharpe after costs
decision_gates.comparison: v2 beats v1 on every TMU seed, not on average
decision_gates.holdout_policy: run only after development choices are frozen
decision_gates.evidence_limit: current-vintage history cannot establish strict revision-point-in-time validity; one predeclared feature change is one trial and is counted as such
